recommendation: Keep this source fix. No further core source change is needed for FHIR-32768 unless the model-info content is regenerated from another upstream source, in which case the generator should preserve cancellationReason while retaining the fhir.ini compatibility rename.
issue_request: FHIR-32768 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking that Appointment.cancelationReason be renamed to Appointment.cancellationReason for R5.
initial_application: The original application, commit a7ac6c3d5a915dbec2b7ba9d005b5ca54a7e144a, changed source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml, the app-4 expression, and the binding name. It did not update source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml, which still exposed the misspelled Appointment element in active FHIR 6.0.0 modelinfo content.
additional_context: Appointment and Library are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and publish.ini copies source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml into the built publication. The old spelling that remains in source/fhir.ini is an intentional R4-to-R6 compatibility map from Appointment.cancelationReason to Appointment.cancellationReason. A later related issue, FHIR-37896, corrected the app-4 status code from no-show to noshow and is separate from this spelling fix.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so the Appointment ClassInfo element name is cancellationReason, matching the authoritative Appointment StructureDefinition and the Jira decision.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: changed the Appointment ClassInfo element name from cancelationReason to cancellationReason.

related_jiras.note: Later PA technical correction for the same app-4 constraint changed the status code from no-show to noshow; it does not alter the FHIR-32768 spelling decision.
